notes.title: New patch (25/9/2018) is now online!
notes.content:
Hello survivors.

I've just uploaded a small patch fixing a couple of minor bugs that (surprisingly) have been unreported since launch.

This update fixes the following issues:
[list][*]Crates no longer block the way to the Medical Room once you obtain the Drug Locker Key.
[*]The ending message will now correctly display whether you saved Tiffany or Alex.[/list]

tags.bug: Crates no longer block the way to the Medical Room once you obtain the Drug Locker Key.
The ending message will now correctly display whether you saved Tiffany or Alex.
